coverage_note: This page primarily defines hazardous areas for electrical installations on marine vessels. Pump and piping components are explicitly identified as creating hazardous zones when conveying flammable liquids (P019, P020), and refueling pumps define hazardous areas in helicopter facilities (P051). Most remaining content covers general hazardous area classifications for various vessel types, paint stores, battery rooms, and electrical equipment certification requirements, which do not constitute direct pump-system relationships.
